description:
Sprague 24"26" Mountain Bike

Hi-Ten Steel Frame - Sturdy, durable and more speedy.

Professional 21-Speed Drivetrain - With grip shifters to help young riders learn the gears easily.
Dual V-brake & XC Tires - Ensure the riding safety.

Durable and Ergonomic

Hi-ten steel rigid frame is strong and durable, with large inertia to increase speed. Its designed frame is also in line with the structure of the human body, making riding more comfortable.

Soft foam saddle ensures comfort and adjustability, thus provides you with a longer and more relaxing ride.

Professional Drivetrain

21-speed drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting with a wide range of gearing, allowing you to easily adapt to various speeds based on your riding preference.

The twist shifters offer fast and reliable gear changes to help riders adapt to the terrain on the trail.

Safe Riding

Equipped V-brakes are lighter and easier to maintain and adjust.

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials, which has strong grip and puncture resistance.

Assembly & Guide

85% pre-assembled, assembly tools included, easy to assemble within 25 minutes.

Click on the video to see an instructional video on assembly.

Hi-Ten Steel Frame

Hiland hi-ten steel is extremely strong and shock resistant, provides you with a more stable operating experience during on-road or off-road riding.

XC Tire

XC tires are made of non-slip and explosion-proof materials, which have strong grip and puncture resistance.

Professional Drivetrain

21-speed drivetrain provides precise and quick shifting, which gives you more control for climbing, descents and corners to enjoy riding.

Double V-brake

V-brake is lighter and easier to maintain and adjust.

Master any terrain with the Hiland Sprague Mountain Bike. Featuring a 21-speed drivetrain, dual disc brakes, and a high-performance suspension fork for ultimate control.
